title: Special Topics in Information Studies; GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs) for Library and Archive Collections
description: Explores new uses of emerging Generative AI (GenAI) and Large Language Model (LLM) technologies in the context of processing cultural heritage materials, with a focus on enhancing description, retrieval, and qualitative analysis of library and archival collections. Focuses on real-world collections and the opportunities, limitations, and risks of applying these new technologies.
